decisions.reason: The combined robot is the flagship embodiment of the firm's public automation commitment and has accumulated further sunk costs, making escalation strongly favor keeping it.
Despite possible overlap with the combined robot, visible commitment and sunk costs in this de-shuttering robot sustain escalation, so withdrawal remains unlikely.
As a core automatic shuttering robot, its centrality and the firm's public automation strategy lead management to persist.
The new product line with several models represents significant investment and is still in ramp-up, so disappointing early results are attributed to temporary causes and escalation favors keeping it.
The software is a recent, publicly visible addition that is close to the integrated offer but less central, so escalation still favors keeping it, though withdrawal risk is somewhat higher.
